messages:
alex.p: Holding the 2.6.0 rollout in us-west-2 — canary p95 jumped and KV cache eviction rate spiked at 15:45. Not safe to continue until we understand root cause.

deploy-bot: Deploybot detected latency anomaly threshold exceeded for canary (p95 > 220ms). Suggested action: pause rollout. See /deploy status 2.6.0. :warning:

sre-oncall: +1 to pause. Can we route new requests to rwd-2.5.4 variant for the next 30m? Prefer manual handoff instead of auto-revert while we triage.

kevin.m: I can execute a staged unwind. Plan: 1) pin traffic in us-west-2 to rwd-2.5.4 at 100% for public routes, 2) keep canary instances in read-only for debugging, 3) start a telemetry capture for 20m. Command to run: ```redwoodctl traffic set --model rwd-2.5.4 --region usw2 --percent 100 --note "emergency unwind"```

linda_rm: We also need a short customer-facing note for impacted dedicated customers in us-west. I'll draft: "We're temporarily rolling back the recent runtime update in US-WEST while we investigate a performance regression. No user data is affected; endpoints will restore to normal in the next hour." Share edits?

jamie: +:thumbsup: Draft looks good. Add that SLOs are being monitored and we'll send a formal incident summary if escalation needed.

deploy-bot: Action taken: traffic update queued by kevin.m. Status: in-progress. Rollout status -> canary: 0%, stable(rwd-2.5.4): 100%. ETA ~45s.

alex.p: After traffic flip, let's not unpin the 2.6.0 tag yet — mark it as "held-investigation" and update release notes to note the hold and reason. We need a rollback matrix entry: whether to auto-retry deploy after X hours or require a sign-off.

kevin.m: traffic update finished. Confirming 100% on rwd-2.5.4 in usw2. Command used: ```redwoodctl pin --model rwd-2.5.4 --region usw2 --traffic 100 --reason "canary latency spike"```

sre-oncall: Telemetry capture started (20m). I'll attach flame graphs to the ticket once it completes.

linda_rm: Sending short note to dedicated customers now. Also updating the release notes draft in the repo under docs/releases/2.6.0.md with a subsection "Hold: US-WEST-2 canary latency spike" and timestamp.

jamie: Quick ops checklist for next steps: 1) confirm no error-rate regressions, 2) validate KV cache config (shard placement + eviction), 3) check recent kernel flags landed in 2.6.0 build. If all clear and root cause identified, we can plan a staged redeploy with smaller traffic slices and extended warmup.

alex.p: Agreed. For auditable traceability, tag the deployment jira: RDW-5123 and add the decision: manual unwind -> held for triage. I'll run the postmortem if it becomes an incident.

deploy-bot: Note: auto-rollback disabled for this release (release policy: manual_review). If someone needs to enable auto actions temporarily, run: `redwoodctl release set-policy 2.6.0 --auto-rollback enable` (requires release-admin).

kevin.m: Leaving canary instances up but isolated (no traffic) so we can repro. Ping me if you want a live debug session.

alex.p: Thanks everyone — solid fast response. We'll reconvene after telemetry window (around 16:05). :hourglass:
